signal.mechanism: high option-implied minus realized equity variance proxies priced global uncertainty; test subsequent MOEX index risk premium, not an option-selling return
signal.formula: (VIX/100)^2 - 252*mean(last21 squared adjacent XNYS close-to-close log SP500 returns); no demeaning or missing-session compression
signal.monthly_rule: at first completed MOEX day of each month, use latest source state available by18:45Moscow; high iff proxy strictly exceeds its previous252-session median excluding current state
signal.primary: three equal monthly cohorts, each high month contributes gross0.3, otherwise0; sum and split equally MIX/RI; all3 consecutive month states must be ready
signal.control: constant gross0.45 split equally MIX/RI on exactly the same readiness masks; matches nominal half-frequency exposure, not ex-post realized exposure
signal.availability: both US inputs assumed known only at23:59:59NewYork on next XNYS session; also respect archived VIX available_at; this lag does not prove original vintages
signal.between_selections: hold monthly weights with causal contract rolls and existing daily integer resizing; no daily refreshing of the frozen monthly signal
signal.warmup: 2018-2020 for trailing features and3monthly cohorts; fresh portfolio cash in2021

limitations: New SP500 information, not V24 VIX/VIX3M governor or V14 RVI scaling. Transfer of the published international mechanism to Russia is unproved, especially after2022 financial segmentation.

Daily close-based realized variance is a noisy proxy, not the paper's intraday realized variance or a statistical forecast of future variance. Current-vintage public quotes and assumed lag do not prove historical original availability.

XNYS calendar is pinned third-party exchange_calendars metadata, not archived exchange announcements. Missing sessions/quotes remain masks. No protected2026 financial observations; future calendar dates alone may identify lag boundaries.

Existing daily candles, fee/margin/spec proxies, integer sizing and separate asset fills; no interest on idle cash. No options, broker, live or demo orders. MIX and RI share equity risk and are not independent bets.

30round trips is fixed before outcomes for two slow quarterly-contract sleeves; no lowering after results. Other Stage1 gates retained.5percent is only a component gate;20-50percent goal remains unverified.
One fixed rule,3months,21/252windows,sign,universe,size and masks. No post-result retuning, regime/year exclusion, control promotion or claim of independent holdout. No new AlgoPack value reads.
